program.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Make her close her jacket fully

outcomes.description: The woman's jacket is closed completely.
outcomes.target: The jacket is fully closed, with its front panels brought together and no visible opening remaining along the closure.
outcomes.reference: The woman's jacket in the input image.

nodes.question: Is the woman's jacket fully closed in the edited image, with its front panels meeting or overlapping throughout the full intended closure?
nodes.criteria: Identify the intended front closure and inspect its upper, middle, and lower portions wherever visible. Pass only if visible evidence establishes continuous meeting or overlap of the front panels throughout the full intended closure, with no unclosed segment. Fail if any clearly visible segment of that closure remains open, even if other segments are obscured or closed. Unknown if no open segment is established but pose, drape, occlusion, or insufficient detail prevents establishing full closure. Outward-hanging fabric, folds, a loose hem, changed silhouette, or absence of a clearly visible gap alone establishes neither full closure nor an open segment.
nodes.binding: Use the woman's jacket in the SOURCE image as the garment reference and assess that same jacket in the EDITED image against the requested fully closed state. Locate the source jacket's front-panel edges and intended closure extent, then compare corresponding garment features and inspect any visible portions of the front-panel meeting line in the edited image, accounting for the changed pose. Do not substitute the outer silhouette for closure evidence. Unrelated changes do not satisfy this condition.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The edited image shows the jacket’s front panels separated, with a clearly visible open gap down the front; they do not meet or overlap throughout the closure.
